items.quote: Social media is broadcasting only the wins of real estate agents.
items.statement: Social media is broadcasting only the wins of real estate agents.

items.quote: we have our red, yellow, and green zones in terms of the parts of the life we show on social media.
items.statement: There are categorized zones representing different aspects of life shown on social media.

items.quote: Red Zone - This may be everything related to your personal life, your family, spouse or your single life if that is so
items.statement: The Red Zone includes personal life aspects that are shared on social media.

items.quote: Yellow Zone - What are your fears when you are receiving ‘no’ from your clients, or when you are not wearing makeup or dressed to impress
items.statement: The Yellow Zone relates to fears about showing vulnerability or failure to clients.

items.quote: Green Zone - Your wins, your MRS or MR Perfect, when you’re always put together and know what to say.
items.statement: The Green Zone consists of publicized successes and appearances.

overview: This source chunk discusses how real estate agents portray their lives on social media, categorizing their experiences into zones based on their visibility and personal expression.
